settings.fixed_background: Same known generating background for both workflows: zero for panel a; B0 + 0.84*S(E) for panel b. No Shirley reconstruction.
settings.statistical_intervals: posterior median and 95% equal-tail interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles
settings.convergence_scope: 8000-step quick-fit budget; full engineering convergence not presumed

comparison: Physics-constrained Bayesian LA MCMC versus independent-parameter LA least squares. Shape, data, fixed known background, window and area definition shared. Priors and statistical objectives still differ.

cases.background_origin: known generating background, fixed identically for both workflows; not rebuilt by Shirley
